title: NEXUS Companion
shortDescription: Companion client for your self-hosted NEXUS personal intelligence OS.
fullDescription:
NEXUS Mobile Companion allows you to monitor, supervise, and interact with your self-hosted NEXUS assistant instance from Android devices and Wear OS smartwatches.

Features:
- Real-time task progress and status monitoring
- Hardware-isolated tactile approval for sensitive actions
- Minimal-distraction vehicle mode for safe hands-free interaction
- Local voice dictation and speech synthesis
- Single-use QR pairing without leaking tokens
- Complete privacy: zero third-party telemetry, all keys stored in Android Keystore.

securityPractices: Data is encrypted in transit using TLS
User can request account/device deletion anytime
